purpose: Capture the declared seven-request Express routing/API conformance scope.

boundary.description: Minimal HTTP application exercising the declared routing and method semantics.
included: Automatic OPTIONS method enumeration and explicit override
Case-insensitive and non-strict route matching defaults
excluded: Other Express middleware, routers, route patterns, parameters, and HTTP methods
Authentication, request body parsing, streaming, redirects, and static files
Full response header equality, timing, and transport-level differences
All Express configuration settings and error paths

scope.description: Seven declared HTTP requests over a minimal route table.

collector.name: Instrumented Express HTTP server
collector.methodDescription: Controlled HTTP requests with response status, body, selected headers, and effective router settings captured.

runtimeRules.subject: HTTP HEAD
runtimeRules.proposition: When no explicit HEAD route exists, a matching GET route handles HEAD; the response body is suppressed and the selected representation headers match GET.
runtimeRules.trigger: A HEAD request matches a path with a GET handler.

applicability.scope: HEAD /widgets only; selected content-type and content-length headers.

runtimeRules.subject: HTTP OPTIONS
runtimeRules.proposition: When no explicit OPTIONS route exists, Express returns the unique methods registered for the matching path and includes HEAD when GET is registered; an explicit OPTIONS route overrides this automatic response.
runtimeRules.trigger: An OPTIONS request matches a path.

runtimeRules.subject: Express router defaults
runtimeRules.proposition: Case-sensitive routing and strict routing are disabled by default.
runtimeRules.trigger: The application lazily initializes its router without explicit overrides.

runtimeRules.subject: Express route matching
runtimeRules.proposition: Default route matching is case-insensitive, permits an optional trailing slash, and matches the pathname independently of the query string.
runtimeRules.trigger: A request path is matched against a registered route.

runtimeRules.subject: Unmatched route
runtimeRules.proposition: A request that matches no registered route continues to the application fallback middleware, which returns the configured 404 response.
runtimeRules.trigger: A request does not match a registered route.

propertyInventory.subject: express-route-dispatch
propertyInventory.rationale: Status, response body, content type, content length, Allow header, and HEAD wire-body bytes for all seven requests.

propertyInventory.subject: express-route-dispatch
propertyInventory.rationale: HEAD uses the GET route when no explicit HEAD route exists; the response body is suppressed and content length matches GET.

propertyInventory.subject: express-route-dispatch
propertyInventory.rationale: Automatic OPTIONS lists unique methods including HEAD for GET; an explicit OPTIONS handler takes precedence.

propertyInventory.subject: express-route-dispatch
propertyInventory.rationale: Case-sensitive routing and strict routing are disabled by default.

propertyInventory.subject: express-route-dispatch
propertyInventory.rationale: Path matching is case-insensitive, allows a trailing slash, and ignores the query string.

propertyInventory.subject: express-route-dispatch
propertyInventory.rationale: An unmatched path falls through to the configured 404 response.

propertyInventory.subject: express-route-dispatch
propertyInventory.rationale: The HEAD response contains zero body bytes on the raw HTTP wire.

propertyInventory.subject: express-route-dispatch
propertyInventory.rationale: An explicit OPTIONS handler takes precedence over automatic method enumeration.

completeness.assessmentMethod: Every required property is linked to observed facet-specific records and retained runtime evidence across all seven requests.
